title: pfaffia cinerea
intro: Pfaffia cinerea, commonly known as "Suma" or "Brazilian Ginseng", is a plant species native to the grasslands and savannas of Brazil and Argentina. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Pfaffia cinerea are attributed to its ability to stimulate the production of white blood cells, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
